title: incident-bot: runbook autodiagnostics helpers and SLO toolkit integration
author: Evan Park
title_and_description:
Motivation: recent on-call drills revealed gaps in how incident-bot surfaces runbook diagnostics and SLO context to responders. This PR adds a set of reusable helpers for runbook autodiagnostics, ties the incident-bot SLO toolkit into the oncall workflow, and standardizes the payload used when linking runbooks from alerts.

Summary of changes: added runbook_autodiag helper library (Python) that normalizes runbook metadata, extracts actionable commands, and computes SLO correlation hints; integrated the SLO toolkit utilities so the incident-bot can attach ranked SLO context to runbook suggestions; updated the incident-bot API and message templates to include compact runbook snippets and quick-link helpers; added unit and integration tests for the new helpers; updated the oncall Slack action flow to surface diagnostics and a small interactive menu for quick-run troubleshooting steps.

Checklist: - [x] Add runbook_autodiag helpers and public API - [x] Wire SLO toolkit summarizer into runbook suggestions - [x] Add unit tests + integration tests for Slack flow - [x] Update documentation for runbook link format - [x] End-to-end verification in staging

Why this matters: responders get higher-quality, prioritized runbook suggestions with SLO context (impact, affected services) which reduces time-to-triage for common SLO-related incidents and makes automated diagnostics more actionable.
